title: Beauty Tea Blend Deck
brands: Beauty: kraft pouch, cream label, deep ruby red wash. Settled from your swipes: roselle calyces 85% from our family organic farm, roselle as the deep red, tart hero and heart of a beauty blend.
WellNest Teas: Three Projects, Project 1: Three New Teas; R107 refresh (Max via WellNest, Oct 17 2026 20:04 ICT), built on the mockups (Max 20:09 ICT).
format_note: Every pick: A = Our Pick (draft, confirm), B = a sensible swap from the source. From Your Swipes items are settled and not asked.
flags_unconfirmed: Name needs a Thai FDA label check before printing.
